notes.title: A new era for Lucky Tabi
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

First of all, we would like to celebrate our victory at our local expo! We had put in a lot of effort into this project and it paid out.

Secondly we would like to share some great news; we have decided to continue development on the game!

This is however accompanied with some bad news.
In order to construct the game properly, and additionally with us switching out engines, we will take quite a while before releasing any updates. We will first have to build up to the point of where we currently are before we can continue building the game up any further.

That means, that there will be quite a while before we release any (playable) updates.
We will try to keep you updated on our progression but please keep in mind that things could take a while. We are all still a bunch of students also trying to do well in our educational careers. ;)

We will keep you updated!

Much love, 
Beyond Abyss Productions
